Manufactured by Crye Precision. Black version.
69ce47ca49b447e32200cbe9 Description: A Crye Precision AirFrame ballistic helmet fitted with M-LOK accessory rails. This configuration is most commonly seen among fans of JP, one of the Arena Champions. Rumor has it that this is the exact type of helmet he once tossed into the air and shot with his final round when he first became champion.
69ce47f01bb66daf5b0d62fd Description: A Crye Precision AirFrame ballistic helmet without accessory rails. When JP was brought into the cleanup crew on Tagilla’s recommendation, this became his first trophy, taken from one of the Arena fighters.
69ce4e3430056e9ce1007c78 Description: An old USGI adapter mount for installing AN/AVS-6 and AN/AVS-9 night vision goggles, used by US Forces in the 1980s. Wonder how this ancient thing turned up in Tarkov.
69ce70a321c1fc42cd01affa Name: Atlant Armour Titan Aramid helmet (OD Green)
69ce70a321c1fc42cd01affa Description: The Titan Aramid ballistic helmet in the form factor copying the Crye Precision AirFrame helmet. Made entirely of aramid, providing an optimal balance between protection and mobility. Equipped with accessory rails and a mount for additional devices. Manufactured by Atlant Armour. OD Green version.
69ce70df606696c00301a760 Description: The Titan Aramid ballistic helmet in the form factor copying the Crye Precision AirFrame helmet. Made entirely of aramid, providing an optimal balance between protection and mobility. Equipped with accessory rails and a mount for additional devices. Manufactured by Atlant Armour. MultiCam version.
69ce70ff49b447e32200cc1c Description: The Titan Aramid ballistic helmet in the form factor copied from the Crye Precision AirFrame helmet. Manufactured by Atlant Armour. The decorations and additional protection were firmly attached by Champion JP, a well-known enthusiast of aggressive close-quarters combat.
69ce8ea6c5fbc777150faf69 Description: A baseball cap in a KLMK Winter camouflage. For those who always wanna look "supreme".
69ce8fa8579d5d18300a1fd3 Description: A baseball cap in a Flecktarn camouflage. For those who always wanna look "supreme".
69ceab1a8562e71bbe063511 Description: A denim cap perfect for those who want to show some style. Must only be worn with the brim facing backward - rules of the Arena.
69ceab3a8562e71bbe063514 Description: A baseball cap in a MultiCam Black camouflage, worn only with the brim facing backward. Ignore and Override.
69cf9696b96c8e8d3e002925 Name: FORT Redut-M body armor (Prisoner of the Arena)
69cf9696b96c8e8d3e002925 Description: A modified version of the well-proven FORT “Redut” body armor, used by several FSB special units. Someone from the cleanup crew spent quite some time painting a "cool skull" and barbed wire on it. Probably thought it looked badass.
69cfbf627eaa38bd240704ad Name: Stich Profi Chest Rig MK2 (Recon, EMR)
69cfbf627eaa38bd240704ad Description: The "Chest-Rig" tactical system can be used as an independent piece of equipment or as an addition to body armor without the MOLLE system. Suitable for combat training instructors, special forces units. Recon preset in EMR camouflage. Manufactured by Stich Profi.
69cfc2d7a9102bdca0080070 Description: A tactical load-bearing system designed to carry magazines, grenades, and special equipment, while using low-profile body armor. Manufactured by London Bridge Trading. MultiCam version.
69cfc7699aed3ea997094cce Description: Ballistic glasses with impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses, manufactured by Revision. Tan version.
69cfc77a596291dd380576e6 Description: Ballistic glasses with impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses, manufactured by Revision. Gray version.
69cfe083ce0df53f230f29b0 Description: Lightweight ballistic glasses manufactured by Wiley X. Black version.
69cfe095b96c8e8d3e002aa3 Description: Lightweight ballistic glasses manufactured by Wiley X. Tan version.
69cfef0d6242b966d40803e7 Description: “Redut-M” is a modified version of the well-proven Redut body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces. Black version.
69cfff5920eac4535609a008 Name: Stich Profi Plate Carrier V2 (A-TACS FG)
69cfff5920eac4535609a008 Description: An improved lightweight version of the standard plate carrier manufactured by Stich Profi. A-TACS FG version.
69cfff99cb69530af90a8279 Description: An improved lightweight version of the standard plate carrier manufactured by Stich Profi. Coyote color version.
69d0517e2819cc454f04d148 Description: This case contains patterns and upgrade schematics for gear that Ref plans to prepare as a unique reward for the new Arena season.
69d0547c7abd8495220354fb Description: A strobe marker light that is used during nighttime operations. It emits signals in the IR region which are visible through NVGs. Uses a special filter when operating in the IR mode. If the filter is removed, it appears as a bright flash in the visible spectrum. In the extended mode operates with a blue flash.
69d26ff4b855150a70092b8c Name: FORT Gladiator-S plate carrier (Death is Inevitable)
69d26ff4b855150a70092b8c Description: The Gladiator-S body armor by FORT, customized by the Arena Champion nicknamed JP. Since his very first appearance in the Arena as a gladiator, he never even thought of washing the blood off it. Why would he? It’s a symbol of strength.
69d27591df93e6952a031c84 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. The lightweight version is designed to provide maximum mobility while protecting vital organs. This black version has been customized by one of the Arena fighters.
69d27ebeb855150a70092ba3 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. The lightweight version is designed to provide maximum mobility while protecting vital organs. MultiCam version.
69d28cdc274c032dd804afe0 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. MultiCam version.
69d36347705756116e0a901c Name: First Spear Strandhogg plate carrier (MultiCam Black)
69d36347705756116e0a901c Description: Taking its name from an Old Norse Viking term for a lightning raid, Strandhögg was one of the first formalized battle tactics to use covert infiltrators in advance of an actual raiding operation. Strandhögg was a tactical game-changer in its time, just like the technological advances First Spear is bringing forward in this line of plate carriers. MultiCam Black version.
69d37050705756116e0a9037 Description: The Haley Strategic D3CRX Combat chest rig is one of the most respected PMC rig systems. Ease and comfort of use are supported by the presence of the optimal number of pouches.
69d3708c8d8009073d0a9df4 Description: A specialized body armor developed for the FSB’s Special Purpose Center, featuring high functionality and modularity. Gray version.
69d39aacf1954acdb3083285 Description: A reward for participation in Season 2 BattlePass “Casus Belli”. Rumor has it, it contains items somehow connected to the Arena Champion known as JP. Designed for the most reckless gladiators and can only be opened within the Arena.
69d3c156cdeff2f448010e2e Description: The Razor electronic ear muffs feature an ultra low-profile design and a rubberized coating for added durability and comfort, also providing optimal hearing protection. Manufactured by Walker's. A version for the true gladiators.
69d46480fe02b60eed07a402 Description: A quality balaclava with a special technological material. But we do not need it for some gimmicky materials. We need it to look tactical and dripped out with the Swedish M90 camouflage.
69e2441a18cb3157560855ec Name: Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (MultiCam Black)
69e2441a18cb3157560855ec Description: A highly customizable modular plate carrier by Spiritus Systems, built for maximum comfort in combat. This MultiCam Black version setup is built by a Black Division operative with the callsign The Wedge.

69f9d547b98cc4120608692a Description: This CD contains a collection of D&B hits by an Oregon DJ who visited Tarkov many times during his tours.

6a4fa628b4831242f306e8cd Description:
A heavy transport crate with no identifying markings. Inside is a random package of Black Division equipment: helmets, body armor, chest rigs, backpacks, or protective gear.

Judging by its contents, this crate was prepared for a team expected to operate far from any safe zone.
6a4ff1e23e95f68a650fcb13 Description: Once assembled, the icebreaker brings back even more memories. It might even bring a tear to your eye, but that could be the tear gas. Press the secret button on the model to make it emit green smoke.
6a55f339fe4be93a04090acc Description: This folder contains fragments of data recovered from the rugged laptop stolen from one of the TerraGroup facilities.
6a59f553acaee8fa5d013979 Description: A noisy technical room, not designed for long periods of time spent inside.
6a5f9becfc12d937d50ae095 Description: This laptop from one of Fence's stashes is stained with the blood of his men and caked in dirt. But the classified data from an unknown TerraGroup facility somewhere in the region is still waiting to be decrypted.
6a5f9c25e8c84d8b0602f22a Description: This rugged laptop is marked with Category A, and its carrying handle has been sealed. That means Black Division specialists have already analyzed the data it contains and intend to prioritize the evacuation of similar hardware.
6a5f9c49b8281c31a1062aea Description: Judging by the label attached to this otherwise ordinary SSD, its contents have yet to be examined by Black Division operatives. Once evaluated and sorted, storage devices like this are assigned to one of the evacuation categories.
6a5f9cfcc409750b6e065592 Description: A folder containing Black Division working notes, most of which are impossible to decipher without internal context. Among the records, however, are lists of encryption keys that may still be valid.

Arena welcome screen description:
Welcome to Arena!

This is where your character, an operator of a private military company (PMC), will battle other fighters for glory and cash. 

Due to the chaos of the conflict, in the city of Tarkov, Norvinsk region, law and order have taken a back seat. This is the place where rich observers have chosen to organize battles where PMCs will fight each other to the last survivor or work as a team to complete a certain objective - which, of course, they will be set by the Masters. 

If you don't own Escape From Tarkov yet, you can purchase the game and transfer all your progress from the Arena there. 
If you already own Escape From Tarkov, all progress gained in the Arena (experience and skills) will also count for your character in EFT and vice versa - progress in EFT counts for Arena.

You are an operator of Battle Encounter Assault Regiment (BEAR), a Russian PMC comprised of ex-special forces officers from all over the post-Soviet states.
BEAR fought in the Contract Wars as a Russian government proxy to uncover the illegal activities of TerraGroup Labs and to bring an end to the continued armed conflict with its security subcontractor, the western-founded private military company USEC.
Select USEC Character:
You are an operator for United Security (USEC), an offshore-established PMC employed by TerraGroup Labs as a security subcontractor.
USEC's primary objective was to destroy any evidence of any potentially illegitimate activities done by its employer and to protect its property from being captured by BEAR, the PMC hired by the Russian government to investigate TerraGroup's operations.

TapesText/sound_info_ice_recorder_tape_s:
<color=#515352>Survivor:</color>
So… if I can’t control this, then I must at least continue observation.

<color=#515352>Survivor:</color>
I am Grigory Altman, supervisor responsible for sample storage aboard the icebreaker “Boreas”. The vessel was…

<color=#515352>Grigory Altman:</color>
…was attacked by mercenaries in Tarkov waters. During the assault, sample containers connected to projects TG-Ci and TG-y were damaged.

<color=#515352>Grigory Altman:</color>
In accordance with containment protocol, the laboratory was isolated from adjacent compartments.

<color=#515352>Grigory Altman:</color>
I remained inside and administered protective compounds as a precaution against possible contamination.

<color=#515352>Grigory Altman:</color>
On the fourth day I recorded elevated cortisol levels, coughing, and mild itching. Increased dosage of the injected medication, observing improvement.

<color=#515352>Grigory Altman:</color>
It is impossible to fully stop the leak or replace the damaged sample containers. I continue daily measurements and it seems…

<color=#515352>Grigory Altman:</color>
…It seems I managed to arrange evacuation to a secure location where I can isolate the samples and continue observation.

<color=#515352>Grigory Altman:</color>
It’s critical to complete this before I enter the paranoia stage…
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_couri:
<color=#515352>Answering Machine:</color>
Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

<color=#515352>Courier:</color>
This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909. I was supposed to deliver urgent mail to Norvinsk, but the roads are fu- busy, so I’m going to be delayed.

<color=#515352>Answering Machine:</color>
Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

<color=#515352>Courier:</color>
This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909. Things are way worse than I thought. Half the roads are blocked. I have no idea if I’ll make it out of Tarkov today. Let the recipient know not to hang up on the call center.

<color=#515352>Answering Machine:</color>
Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

<color=#515352>Courier:</color>
This is a complete clusterfuck! They're stopping everyone at the checkpoint, the line's already kilometers long. The truck driver in front of me started arguing with them, and they fucking shot him! Are you fucking hearing this?! A stray bullet hit my car! I almost fucking died!

<color=#515352>Courier:</color>
You know what, I don't get paid for this. I’m getting outta here on foot to my family. I’m leaving the car, all the parcels are inside. Life’s more important. If you send someone — the key… the key is under the wheel.
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_culti:
<color=#515352>Priest:</color>
The new masters of the world are already here, and the process has begun… The New World has started to take shape, and the Wardens have already been chosen.

<color=#515352>Priest:</color>
Know that the Eye of the World has been watching you for a long time, and all… all your deeds are imprinted in the memory that the Wardens will carry from the old world into the new. Soon, it will be the only thing of value.

<color=#515352>Priest:</color>
I knew you would come here. It was all foretold. We awaited the Blind One who would help us prepare everything for the Riders of the Arrival. And in you… we found him.

<color=#515352>Priest:</color>
Behold the power of The Unheard before it is too late…
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_igor_:
<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
Tape #1. Time is… time is 14:09. My name’s Igor. I feel like some secret agent doing this. I even had to switch to analog recordings. You know, with a tape recorder. At least that way any of those freaks can’t hack it.

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
Yesterday someone slipped a book under my door. Creepy as hell, covered in those same symbols that started showing up around the city…  At first I thought it was some prank. Like, you know, that old TV show, Naked and Funny. Damn, that one sure is an oldie…

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
Anyway, the book! I read it. Spent the whole evening on it. And it’s full of… of some serious weirdness. Not nonsense, no. More like… I don’t know, like someone knows things they really shouldn’t know.

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
Well, our Cobalt is connected to TerraGroup, and over the years I’ve learned a few things. So these… these "Gifts" mentioned in the book sound an awful lot like some of TerraGroup’s projects. The secret type.

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
I’m sure they tried to recruit me. Like, into some cult. Only these guys are way more sophisticated than your average Peoples Temple types. They think I have access to some "Eye of the World". That’s why they need me. And they’re not gonna stop at just sending a book.

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
I have to run. Yes… yes, I need to disappear. Lay low, maybe even in Bruges.

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
They’ve been watching me. This whole time. And I thought it was just paranoia. Even talked about it with my therapist, for fuck’s sake! I should’ve trusted my gut. Maybe I wouldn’t have to drop everything and run now. I…

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
The last tape ran out. I didn’t think it would happen this fast. Alright, I’ll make this quick.

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
Anyway, those guys… those guys in hoods… They’re watching me. I just found a note stuck in my door. You know, between the door and the frame—whatever! It said something about the "Eye of the World", that I look through it and it looks back at me… The Priests called me the chosen one!

<color=#515352>Cult Victim:</color>
I need to run. I’m recording this on my way to the train station. I have to get out of here, doesn’t matter where or how anymore!
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_labyr:
<color=#515352>TerraGroup Scientist:</color>
This is Nikolay Voronenko speaking. The Labyrinth is the worst technically equipped TerraGroup facility, we have already lost contact with headquarters. Perhaps one of the test subjects cut the cable…

<color=#515352>TerraGroup Scientist:</color>
The facility was stormed by BEAR mercenaries. To defend the Labyrinth I had to release the test subjects from groups 3 and 12. Judging by the sounds, only the test subjects are left outside now, I can’t hear any of the BEARs.

<color=#515352>TerraGroup Scientist:</color>
The experiments carried out in the Labyrinth are too important and too dangerous to lose the results. So I gathered all the facility documentation into a folder and sent it to the stock.

<color=#515352>TerraGroup Scientist:</color>
I don’t know if I’ll make it to the evacuation point… but during the chase I managed to grab a pistol from one of the BEARs. It will be a last resort.
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_morem:
<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
…He's like a mother duck!

<color=#515352>Taran:</color>
Explain.

<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
You don’t get it, Taran? Like a fucking mother duck! Remember how… how Voevoda got us out of the line of fire last time. Made us all walk outta there in a straight line like some ducklings. Fucking… heh…

<color=#515352>Taran:</color>
Yeah, I remember. No one got hurt, at least. And the job was done.

<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
Well I’m not saying it’s a bad thing! Who do you take me for? Our commander is like a real batya to me.

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
What are we up to here, pups?

<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
Comrade commander, everything here is strictly by the book! Come join us!

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
No thanks. Alright, get ready, we’re heading out soon.

<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
Aye, commander!

<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
I hope this comes through. I don’t know if we’ll make it, so I’m leaving this recording.

<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
When we were getting to the fallback point, Yastreb totally fucking snapped and started shooting at us! We put him down fast, but we walked into an ambush: shitheads came at us from every direction. Fuck. Guess the shooting… the shooting was… was a signal, damn it. Fuck. Motherfucking traitor…

<color=#515352>Moreman:</color>
We're still operational, but we got hit hard. Requesting help. Listen guys, I don’t hold it against-
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_start:
<color=#515352>USEC Operative:</color>
Commander! How much longer do you reckon we'll be stuck here?

<color=#515352>USEC Squad Leader:</color>
For as long as they tell us to. TerraGroup still has a fuckload of unclosed facilities in Tarkov.

<color=#515352>USEC Operative:</color>
You think they’ll manage to pull everything out on time? Even with their resources, it sounds impossible.

<color=#515352>USEC Squad Leader:</color>
Let them set their priorities themselves. We’ve already got our hands full babysitting HVIs and hauling out TerraGroup’s docs. 

<color=#515352>USEC Operative:</color>
But still, even if everything is moved out, there will be hundreds of digital drives left behind… There’s no way to evacuate something like that in war conditions.

<color=#515352>USEC Squad Leader:</color>
They're not gonna extract everything, okay? I heard TerraGroup has some kind of weapon that wipes data from the systems. All of it.

<color=#515352>USEC Operative:</color>
Like an EMP? Surely they’re gonna give us a heads-up, right? It would screw all our coordination.

<color=#515352>USEC Squad Leader:</color>
Why would they hide this from us? Even if they do end up using this thing, it'll only be after we're evacuated. Without our PMC support, they wouldn't last long — they have no one but us.

<color=#515352>USEC Operative:</color>
What about those “contractors” we transferred the HVIs to? They looked quite serious. No, shady too. No insignias, no patches… Who are they anyway?

<color=#515352>USEC Squad Leader:</color>
There is no info on them from the HQ, so clearly we shouldn't get involved in that shit. They might be linked to that specialist guy over at the lighthouse. Or perhaps they're just an escort crew from outside the border — our guys are stretched thin here. Either way, we can't trust them.

<color=#515352>USEC Operative:</color>
Makes you wonder how fast TerraGroup would’ve been screwed up without us involved… Especially now, when even some of our own commanders are straying away from their orders…

<color=#515352>USEC Squad Leader:</color>
Listen, watch your mouth! Any other situation, and I'd have you deployed somewhere far worse! So shut up. SHUT UP!

<color=#515352>USEC Operative:</color>
Uh, yes sir!

<color=#515352>Squad Leader:</color>
To all BEAR survivors! The explosion knocked out all our electronics, I repeat, our comms are out! Operation is canceled! Fall back to the evacuation points on your own! Move with caution. Code phrase - "water is wet"!

<color=#515352>Squad Leader:</color>
To all USEC units! Blast killed all our electronics — no comm with the HQ. We’ve lost control of the facility. Evacuate through Exfil Three towards the port… Exfil Three! Expect enemy contact, proceed with caution. Any non-USEC individuals are to be considered hostile! Defend yourselves. Use sound judgment.
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_tgmee:
<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Friends! Who’s still out there? Dmitry Sergeevich, come in and close the door, please. Thank you. Are all departments represented? I see they are. Let us begin, then.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
By now, everyone’s noticed that communications have been down since this morning and many divisions are in lockdown. I’d like to say this is just another drill, but this time it’s very serious. We received an order from New York today. We’re evacuating.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Quiet, colleagues! I understand your concern, but we have to stay focused. I initiated the protocol a few hours ago. The specialists are already working on data destruction and sealing the premises. 

<color=#515352>A.P..:</color>
All projects in Tarkov are being shut down, including affiliated enterprises. From now on, contact with them will be handled only through… hmm… Gennady Viktorovich, I don’t see you, raise your hand, please. There, that’s the man you’ll need. I believe there shouldn’t be any issues. Those drills we ran weren’t for nothing…

<color=#515352>Question from the audience:</color>
Half of my samples aren’t ready yet. What’s going to happen to them?

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Pyotr Alekseevich, please, hold your questions…

<color=#515352>Question from the audience:</color>
Excuse me, what about the large equipment?

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
The centrifuge has already been disassembled, literally an hour ago. Enough! Time is precious right now!

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
You’ll be able to ask your questions at the end, but for now, let’s stay on topic. Key personnel will be evacuated to the Health Resort — many of you have already vacationed there before. It’s now being used as an interim evacuation site. Logistics, escort, and security are handled by United Security personnel.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
But be careful! Our cooperation with them ends immediately after arrival at the Health Resort! After that point, a new contractor will make contact, and management strongly advises against approaching USEC operatives.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
I understand your concerns! I don’t have all the information myself, but I’m confident that our new partners will be just as reliable as USEC personnel. TerraGroup has always prioritized security and will entrust our evacuation only to true professionals.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Speaking of the evacuation… In 13 hours and 47 minutes, all TerraGroup facilities must be vacated. Yes, this is the first time we’re working under such a rush, but there’s no other way.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
I’ve received the codes, "Braun" and "Chernigov" included… Also from Lisbon. So by the time the timer runs out, no one should be left here! I’ll be evacuating last. Well, not just me. Korneev, are you here?

<color=#515352>Korneev:</color>
Yes.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Good. Once everything is sealed, we’ll head to the Health Resort.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
I understand, colleagues. It’s hard to realize that all production must be shut down. We won’t be able to take microbiology at all, just the data and parameters…

<color=#515352>Shout from the audience:</color>
How are we supposed to leave all this? We spent a year setting up the lab!

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Galina Petrovna, calm down! Everything will be fine at the new location.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Alright, one more thing, this is important! Ahem, excuse me, I have to take this…

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Hello? Yes, "Schliss 14"… Already… Yes… Wait, right now? Understood… Give me two minutes, I’ll find a spot.

<color=#515352>A.P.:</color>
Friends! It's an extremely urgent call, I need to step away. My apologies. I’ll be back soon.
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_voevo:
<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
To the commander of the Gnezdo base. Reporting. After the combat task was completed, someone detonated an explosive. We have casualties among USEC operators and civilians. One of ours is critically wounded, the rest have light injuries. Assistance required. I repeat, assistance required!

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
Ahem… I never kept a diary. Thought it was a stupid idea. But now I feel like I should share my thoughts with someone.

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
The Bogatyrs got into a bad mess. Some of my boys are dead, others wounded. Maybe that is why I keep thinking this is not an accident.

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
This is not only happening here. Tarkov, conflicts in the Middle East, hunger, poverty, global warming…

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
People seem to be going mad! But strangely, it’s very sudden. A decent family man turns and shoots his little girls. It's the same here. Tarkov used to be a prosperous city. People came here on purpose. Then… the sore burst and it spilled out…

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
What if it’s the Earth itself trying to rid itself of the filth, this humanity virus? People only harm this planet. Maybe this is the end for all of us?

<color=#515352>Voevoda:</color>
I do not know. But those thoughts just keep coming. End transmission.
TapesText/sound_info_recorder_tape_witne:
<color=#515352>Deputy Minister Shkurenko:</color>
…so. There are no exact dates yet. We think everything will start in about… three months. You and your, um, team should move in right after our signal.

<color=#515352>Chepyga:</color>
And the cops? I’m not sending my boys to their deaths for nothing.

<color=#515352>Deputy Minister Shkurenko:</color>
The mayor is aware and will take care of it. The pay is good, considering all your risks. Sponsors pay in foreign currency, just the way we like it.

<color=#515352>Chepyga:</color>
So the old scheme, then?

<color=#515352>Deputy Minister Shkurenko:</color>
Only this time you'll be able to take control of the whole city. Once the dust settles, obviously.

<color=#515352>Chepyga:</color>
Shit's getting serious. There'll be a lots of bodies.

<color=#515352>Deputy Minister Shkurenko:</color>
There will be a lot of blood spilled, but not yours and not ours, assuming we act together. Equipment, weapons, medical supplies — everything will be provided. Your tasks are tough, we won’t leave you without support.

<color=#515352>Chepyga:</color>
We’ll need more people. And waste a couple of local big shots beforehand so they don’t start nosing around. It’ll be harder if we don't do it soon enough.

<color=#515352>Deputy Minister Shkurenko:</color>
If you handle it cleanly, I’ll help cover it up. After things heat up, we won’t have trouble finding volunteers.

<color=#515352>Chepyga:</color>
Aight. When do we get the guns?

<color=#515352>Shkurenko's assitant:</color>
Yaroslav Grigoryevich, look…

<color=#515352>Chepyga:</color>
Hey you! The fuck you doing here?! Come here!

Trading/Dialog/Btr/News1: Some assholes pillaged my depot! I managed to stay out, but the situation's still fucked up! I gotta beat them out of there... But first, I need a new place to settle in. Afterwards, I'll look for someone who can help. Anything comes up, I'll get in touch with you, okay?

Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_bleed-1: Always pay close attention to your character's health
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_bleed-2: Assign various medical items to the quick access panel to quickly use them when necessary.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_doors-2: Some doors may need a corresponding key or keycard to open. You can’t open those by force.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_equip-2: The technical basement of this building has become a BEAR staging point for the TerraGroup office assault. There are likely lots of supplies. Grab everything you can, you might need it later.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_examination-2: Exploration pays off. Study dangerous areas from a distance, look for passages through buildings, locked doors, and underground tunnels to optimize your route. It'll help you avoid trouble and might just keep you alive.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_exit_zones-2: To leave the location, you need to find an extraction point. They are often marked with a green flare, flashlight, or other visual indicators. Some extractions may require money or specific items.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_exits-1: To leave, stay inside the extraction zone for a certain period of time until the extraction is complete.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_exits-2: Some extractions may require money or specific items on you.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_final-2: The extraction point from the Ground Zero is close. But without communication with command, no one knows how much time or effort it will take to get out of Tarkov. Most will die trying to evacuate. Yet those willing to see it through to the end might still have a chance.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_fracture-2: Assign various medical items to the quick access panel to quickly use them when necessary.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_grenade-2: To pull out a grenade, it must be placed in your pockets or tactical rig. The quick access panel shows which grenade will be pulled out next.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_hydration-2:
Your hydration and energy gradually decrease during a raid.
If you ignore your PMC’s needs, you will start losing stamina and health, eventually leading to death.
Plan ahead — bring extra supplies if you expect your next raid to be a long one.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_intro-2:
During the assault on TerraGroup’s main office, a strange explosion cut off all contact with command. Now the goal is simple — get out of the city center.
The main team is already heading for extraction, but your commander left a tape with orders for anyone who got separated, along with some medicine and supplies. To assess the situation and plan your escape, you need to listen to the tape.
It seems some lights are dead. Luckily, your sidearm still has a working flashlight.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_inventory-1: You don’t know what’s ahead. Check your inventory and make sure you’re ready for combat.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_inventory-3: The Gear tab shows everything equipped on your PMC.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_inventory-4: The Health tab shows your PMC's current health status.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_inventory-5: The Tasks tab shows all current missions and objectives.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_location_zones: Your skills and experience are your best tools in this chaos. Learn and remember points of interest on different locations. Surviving means planning your raid and mapping your route ahead of time. Valuable loot in Tarkov doesn’t come easy — you’ll have to fight for it.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_loot_container:
You can search dead enemies, bags, crates, and other types of containers.
Not every container holds valuable loot, but each one is worth checking.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_malf-2: Your weapon is jammed. Inspect it, identify the cause, and fix it. Just a sidearm won’t cut it in a fight.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_mines-2: In the Norvinsk region, everyone turned on each other in an instant. Watch out — enemies will set traps and ambush you at every turn.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_prefight-2: The last fight is barely over, and a new one is already coming. The Scavs — savage bandits and thugs — are hunting anyone who survived the blast. Get ready for a gunfight.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_secret_zones-2: Some paths may appear blocked-off, but they are actually passable.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_time-2:
Keep an eye on the remaining raid time.
If you fail to leave the raid before the timer runs out, your character will gain the "Missing in Action" status and you will lose all the gear you brought with you and found during the raid.
Tutorial/tutorial_trigger_volting-2: Tarkov is in ruins. Expect obstacles, barricades, and hidden ways out wherever you go.
Tutorial_CharacterSelection_Description: As Scav, you don’t risk your main character's gear, but if you survive the raid, all gear and loot can be transferred to your stash. Moreover, other AI-controlled NPC will consider you as one of their own, as long as you don't kill or insult anyone of them. However, while playing as Scav, the main character will not receive experience or improve any skills. \n\nPlaying as Scav is limited by a cooldown time. It's a good way to get familiar with the game without risking valuable equipment.
Tutorial_CloseConfirmationDialog_Descrip: The tutorial can be restarted only by resetting the player profile. \n\n Are you sure you want to skip it?
Tutorial_ConfirmationDialog_Description: The game is currently in early access and is undergoing constant development. To get a quicker grip on interface and controls, please consider taking this brief training course. You can turn it off at any moment. \n\n Do you wish to start the training?
Tutorial_Confirmation_Description: You can invite your friends to join the group, if they have chosen the same location and the time of day. To do this, right-click on the player's nickname and select Invite to group. The maximum number of players in group is limited to 5. \n\nWhen the team is assembled and ready, click Ready to start the raid.
Tutorial_EndScreenCongrats_Description: Congratulations! \n Now you can venture to explore the Tarkov universe on your own and try to escape the city.
Tutorial_InfiltrationAreaSelection_Descr: Taking a raid area map with you will allow you to choose the point of entry and see the possible exit locations. To see currently available exits during the raid, hit the "O" key twice. Exits can be both permanent and temporary. Temporary exits get closed if somebody has already fulfilled specified conditions, for example, if someone has already used the car as a way out, the car leaves and cannot be activated again. If the character doesn’t have a map with him, the entry point will be chosen randomly.
Tutorial_InsuranceSelection_Description: Here you can insure your items. \n\nIn case of your death, if these items were not picked up and carried out by another player, they will get back to you over insurance return.
Tutorial_LocationSelection_Description: You can choose one of the available maps. Each of them has its own characteristics -- such as raid duration and number of players -- and features a certain part of Tarkov. If you linger and don’t extract until the end of the raid, your character will be considered missing in action. By choosing time of the day, you will be spawned in the respective lighting conditions. Also, please mind the current weather conditions. A number of maps are still in development and therefore not available yet.
Tutorial_OfflineModeSelection_Descriptio: Check the offline mode box to test and try anything without having to worry about your gear in case of death. All features will be available, including AI enemies, if you enable PvE. \n\nHowever, no other players, naturally.
Tutorial_Pmc_Description: This is your main character. You choose his equipment yourself, and his skills get upgraded and saved with every raid. Other players and Scavs will recognize you as a former PMC operative, with respective consequences. \n\nIf you get killed, you risk losing the equipment, however, you can buy a new one or procure something in the raid. Remember, only combat makes you tougher.
Tutorial_Savage_Description: As Scav you don’t risk your main character's gear, but if you survive the raid, all gear and loot can be transferred to your stash. Moreover, other AI-controlled NPC will consider you as one of their own, as long as you don't kill or insult anyone of them. However, in this case, the main character will not receive experience or upgrade skills. \n\nPlaying as a local scum is limited by a cooldown time. It's a good way to get familiar with the game without risking valuable equipment.
Tutorial_TabGearAmmoControl_Description: Loading magazines To load the magazine, drag the ammo onto it, but check if they are compatible first. To remove the ammo from the magazine or to eject the magazine from the weapon, please select the respective entries in the shortcut menu. Magazine or ammo will be dropped to the first free slot of the stash -- or vest, if the weapon was equipped by you. Use Ctrl + click to quickly store items to the backpack/vest/pockets or to unload them into stash. The ability to search and loot quickly is extremely important in combat conditions.
Tutorial_TabGearHandBag_Description: The pouch holds a secured container. Items from this container can not be removed from your body after death. We recommend you store particularly valuable items there; such as money, rare medicines, keys, etc.
Tutorial_TabGearInspectBeltWeaponModify_:
The game features highly detailed and realistic weapon models and behavior. Hence, any changes will affect the performance characteristics and ergonomics. 

In order to install another detail or device you just need to select it in the dropdown list in the respective slot. 

Please note that installing various modules also changes the dimensions of the weapon. Make sure you have enough inventory space to customize the weapon.
Tutorial_TabGearInspectBeltWeapon_Descri: Double clicking on any object will display info about it. Here you can see the weapon's characteristics, its parts and mods, and a brief description. Some items may not be known in advance. In this case, their icons are blacked out and their name is replaced with question marks. Such items should be examined. The examination takes some time, but after that, the item can be used. The game allows customization of weapons, which can be accessed by clicking the gear icon or from the right-click menu.
Tutorial_TabGearQuickBar_Description: It’s best to put loaded magazines, ammo and grenades into your chest rig or pockets to enable quick reload with the R button. In other words, it’s only magazines (or grenades) that are in the chest rig that count. \n\nAlso, unlike the backpack, items from chest rig and pockets are available for quick access in the raid through keys 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0, if you assign them a slot by moving them there.
Tutorial_TabGearReadyForEscape_Descripti: To install the magazine, simply drag it over the weapon. In order to adapt more quickly, try different tactics and experiment more. Escape from Tarkov is a hardcore shooter and therefore its main core is you, your knowledge and experience, and how you use them in combat. We also suggest you to examine the Controls section in the game settings to remember the main combat commands. Are you ready to escape?
Tutorial_TabGearStash_Description: Your Stash is a storage place for trophies from raids and purchased items. Its size is limited, so we advise arranging items in a compact manner. The stash size can be indirectly increased by using specialized item containers, which are available from merchants. Also, in the future, you will be able to increase the size of your stash in the Hideout. Owners of the Edge of Darkness Edition already have the maximum stash size from the start. \n\nTo rotate an object, press the R key while dragging it.
Tutorial_TabGear_Description: The Gear tab contains your character’s equipment interface. Each slot is allocated for a specific type of equipment. Everything you take with you into the raid can be removed from your body by other players in case of your death. You can decrease your losses by using Insurance. If the insured item wasn't looted during the raid, you will get it back.
Tutorial_TabHealth_Description: The Health tab displays the state of your health by body part, current levels of hydration and energy, and other characteristics. You can also track the state of each body part separately. For example, if you received a bleeding wound to the leg, it will be reflected with the appropriate status icon. By dressing the wound, you’ll be able to stop bleeding and subsequent loss of hit points. Thoroughly prepare for raids beforehand, bringing reserves of essential medicines. And don't forget about the painkillers!
Tutorial_TabOverall_Description: This is your main character. Here, it shows your level, the number of raids and kills, your efficiency and other stats. \n\nInfo from all tabs is available both in the Character section of the main menu and by pressing Tab in a raid.
Tutorial_TabTradeBuy_Description: To purchase an item, select it from the shop, press the Fill items button at the bottom of the screen to allocate payment, and then press DEAL at the top of the screen to confirm the transaction. \n\nSome things cannot be bought for money, and you will need to obtain the necessary barter items first.
Tutorial_TabTradeQuest_Description: The best way to increase the trader's loyalty level is to run errands and carry out tasks. However, be careful as some of them may ask you to do things that will hurt your reputation with other merchants. \n\nLet's take the first quest.
Tutorial_TabTradeSell_Description: To sell an item, open the Sell tab, and then drag the items you want sold to the area in the middle of the screen. Then, click DEAL. \n\nDifferent traders offer different price for the same goods. Some items are only of interest to certain traders.
Tutorial_TabTrade_Description: Here you can see the list of merchants. All of them are based in Tarkov, just like you, and have their own interests. Every one of them has his or her own needs and specifics in the range of items for purchase or on sale. Traders have several levels of loyalty, with every level gives access to new products. Loyalty depends on your reputation with a merchant, your level, and the amount of money spent. One example is Prapor.

Ui/Settings/Hint/AdaptiveSharpen: A smart sharpening filter that enhances clarity only where needed. Used to counter slight blur from DLSS or FSR and improve detail without excessive artifacts.
Ui/Settings/Hint/AmdFsr22: An image upscaling technology that improves performance and visual quality using temporal upscaling. Works on most graphics cards without additional hardware requirements.
Ui/Settings/Hint/AmdFsr3: An image upscaling technology that additionally uses Frame Generation to increase FPS by 1.5 to 2 times. May slightly increase input lag.
Ui/Settings/Hint/AnisoFilter: Improves the quality of textures viewed at sharp angles.
Ui/Settings/Hint/Antialiasing:
FXAA — Low performance impact, but may blur the image;

TAA — A modern anti-aliasing method with minimal performance impact and less blurring. May cause flickering and object ghosting.
Ui/Settings/Hint/ChromaticAberrations: Adds color fringing at object edges for a cinematic effect. May reduce image clarity and cause eye strain.
Ui/Settings/Hint/ClearRam: Enables forced memory cleanup between raids to improve performance. Recommended for players with less than 16 GB RAM.
Ui/Settings/Hint/ColorBlind: Adjusts environment colors to ensure important gameplay elements remain distinguishable for players with color vision deficiencies. Doesn't impact performance.
Ui/Settings/Hint/DlssPreset:
F — Default preset for Max Performance and DLAA modes.

J — Improves DLSS upscaling and image detail. Affects Performance and Quality modes and delivers better results compared to other CCN models.

K — Enhanced version of preset J that reduces grass flickering and ghosting artifacts.

L — Provides stronger sharpening and enhanced detail emphasis. Delivers a crisp image in Quality and Performance modes but may increase flickering of thin details in certain scenes.

M — Prioritizes image stability. Produces a smoother and more stable image compared to Preset L.
Ui/Settings/Hint/EnablePostFx: Post-processing effects applied after the main rendering pass. Used to enhance visuals, atmosphere, or scene realism.
Ui/Settings/Hint/Fov: Shows how wide the visible game world is. Higher values provide a wider field of view.
Ui/Settings/Hint/FramerateLimit:
When enabled, the frame rate limit caps maximum FPS, reduces hardware load, prevents overheating, and ensures stable frame pacing.

When disabled, the game renders the maximum possible FPS, improving smoothness and reducing input lag. This increases GPU and CPU load and may cause FPS fluctuations on low-end systems.
Ui/Settings/Hint/GrassShadow: Adds realistic shadows to grass, increasing scene depth and detail.
Ui/Settings/Hint/Hbao: Adds soft ambient shadows for greater depth and improved spatial perception.
Ui/Settings/Hint/HeadBobbing: Enhances immersion, but high values may cause motion sickness.
Ui/Settings/Hint/HqColor: Improves color accuracy and smoothness for a more realistic image. May increase GPU load and require compatible monitors.
Ui/Settings/Hint/InvertX: Inverts horizontal camera movement. Moving the mouse right turns the view left and vice versa.
Ui/Settings/Hint/InvertY: Inverts vertical camera movement. Moving the mouse backward looks up, moving it forward looks down.
Ui/Settings/Hint/LumaSharpen: A filter that increases the clarity of light and dark details without affecting colors. Makes the image more contrast-rich. High values may introduce grain and noise.
Ui/Settings/Hint/MalfunctionVisibility: Displays notifications about weapon malfunctions in the corner of the screen.
Ui/Settings/Hint/MipStreaming: Loads textures dynamically on demand to save video memory. May temporarily reduce detail on distant objects. Recommended for graphics cards with less than 8 GB of VRAM.
Ui/Settings/Hint/Noise: Adds film grain to the image.
Ui/Settings/Hint/NvidiaDlss: A technology that improves performance and overall image quality. Effective at reconstructing small details. Supported only on RTX graphics cards and may slightly blur the image on high-resolution displays.
Ui/Settings/Hint/NvidiaReflexLowLatency: Reduces system latency between input actions and on-screen response. Useful when you need fastest reaction time.
Ui/Settings/Hint/PreloadHideout: Increases resource usage in the main menu but speeds up Hideout loading.
Ui/Settings/Hint/Resampling:
Changes the internal rendering resolution without altering the game window size.
Performance impact depends on the selected value.
Ui/Settings/Hint/SetAffinity: Disables the use of virtual CPU cores.
Ui/Settings/Hint/SpectatingEnable:
On – Allows you to spectate allies in the group after your death.
Off – After death, you are automatically moved to the post-raid summary screen.
Ui/Settings/Hint/Ssr: Adds reflections only for objects currently visible on screen. More resource-efficient than Ray Tracing but may introduce visual artifacts.
Ui/Settings/Hint/TraderIntermediateScree: Shows a separate trader selection screen when opening the Trading tab.
Ui/Settings/Hint/Usage/AvgDecrease-Fov: Slightly reduces performance (at higher FOV values)
Ui/Settings/Hint/Usage/HIGH_DECREASE_Res: Significantly reduces performance (at 2x or higher values)
Ui/Settings/Hint/Usage/LowIncrease-Frame: Slightly increases performance but may reduce stability
Ui/Settings/Hint/Usage/ResamplingTitle: Unavailable when DLSS, FSR 2.2, or FSR 3.0 is enabled.
Ui/Settings/Hint/VSync: Limits FPS to the monitor refresh rate to reduce screen tearing.
Ui/Settings/Hint/VolumeLight: Provides realistic light beams and shadow scattering. Can heavily load the GPU.
Ui/Settings/Hint/ZBlur: Adds depth-of-field blur to objects out of focus, enhancing visual immersion.

Welcome screen description:
Welcome to Escape from Tarkov!
In this game, you will have to fight for your life and survive the perils of Tarkov, a Russian city in the Norvinsk region on the brink of chaos and collapse. Your character is an operator of a Private Military Company (PMC), caught in a maelstrom of events right after the Contract Wars. The area is sealed off, and your operational command is not responding; previous mission objectives have lost their purpose. Everybody has personal goals now – adapt and survive, escape the blockade or try to save others.

Be prepared to die and lose everything you had with you in every raid you enter.
Keep in mind that every drop in your internet connection or hardware malfunction can lead to disconnection from the game with the consecutive death of your character and loss of all the gear you had with you or found within your raid.

Yes, you will die, and most probably very often, but remember – this is still a game. Best of luck out there!

hideout/Welcome:
Welcome to your personal Hideout! For now it is an old bomb shelter clogged with rubbish, but by making an effort you can make it a full-fledged underground base with everything you need for comfortable living.

You can use items and resources you found in raids to build and improve various areas of the Hideout, many of which will give you special bonuses and abilities - increased rate of off-raid health regeneration, energy and hydration, boosted skills leveling, the ability to craft various items, etc.

Escaping from Tarkov can take quite a while, and you need a place where you can regroup and regain strength. This is the place - your Hideout.

Good luck!

hideout_area_0_stage_1_description: Ventilation duct suspended from the ceiling. The air duct passes through part of the room, providing the natural movement of air flows. It is necessary for the installation of "smoky" zones where the output of combustion products is required.
hideout_area_0_stage_2_description: A basic ventilation duct with additional emergency bunker ventilation system of external airflow. Now, besides the removal of combustion products, there will be fresh air in the Hideout.
hideout_area_0_stage_3_description: A ventilation duct fitted with electric fans to increase the airflow rate. A complete air circulation system is needed for advanced production and chemical research.
hideout_area_10_stage_1_description: Everybody needs a place to work with their tools. A simple workbench allows you to do the basic modifications of your weapon and disassembling various technical parts.
hideout_area_10_stage_2_description: A workplace equipped with everything necessary for the production of simple ammunition and more complex technical tasks required to improve your hideout.
hideout_area_10_stage_3_description: A full-fledged table of the gunsmithing master. It allows you to produce more advanced cartridges and engage in high-tech tasks, assembly and disassembly of complex electronic devices and mechanical systems.
hideout_area_11_stage_1_description: If the generator is the heart of the Hideout, then the intelligence center is its brain. For now, this is just an old table and chair for analyzing various information that can help you escape from Tarkov.
hideout_area_11_stage_2_description: An advanced intelligence center equipped with a laptop, which has more working space due to an additional table. Thanks to Mechanic, it is connected to an isolated computer network, which remained intact after the EMP strike and isolation of Tarkov.
hideout_area_11_stage_3_description: A full-fledged intelligence center equipped with computer equipment, radio devices and analytical tools. The escape from Tarkov was never so close.
hideout_area_12_stage_1_description: A specially equipped place for shooting firearms. For the convenience of evaluating the shooting results, the range is equipped with metal silhouette popper targets for the close range, and paper targets for the long range.
hideout_area_12_stage_2_description: An improved range with installed ceiling-mounted target rails with three speed levels.
hideout_area_12_stage_3_description: An advanced shooting range with installed popper targets and a laptop for configuration. Also allows to start training with random rail targets and poppers, scores are displayed on the laptop monitor.
hideout_area_13_stage_1_description: Home library with various fiction and popular science books and magazines.
hideout_area_14_stage_1_description: A special box where specially hired Scavs drop off various items that they've found.
hideout_area_15_stage_1_description: Basic lighting with paraffin candles, giving a dim and uneven light.
hideout_area_15_stage_2_description: Hideout lighting with incandescent bulbs. The illumination is more even and brighter than from the candles.
hideout_area_15_stage_3_description: Hideout lighting with fluorescent lights provides optimal brightness and uniformity of illumination.
hideout_area_16_stage_0_description: This wall would be perfect to house a grandma's sideboard of collectibles.
hideout_area_16_stage_1_description: The Hall of Fame is a special rack where you can put your trophies and collectibles.
hideout_area_16_stage_2_description: A great rack from IDEA that can very nicely hold all the figurines found in raids and several dogtags taken from PMCs.
hideout_area_17_stage_1_description: Air filtration system, connected to the common ventilation system. It provides the air which is as cleanest from harmful impurities as possible.
hideout_area_18_stage_1_description: Surface-mounted solar-wind batteries improve the overall Hideout power generation.
hideout_area_19_stage_1_description: The moonshine still allows you to produce strong drinks directly in your Hideout.
hideout_area_1_stage_1_description: A basic front door. So that all kinds of fools don't come to pay you a visit. It does not save from drafts and moisture, but it creates the feeling that the Hideout is slowly getting settled.
hideout_area_1_stage_2_description: An improved entrance hall with a reinforced door, a clothes hanger, and other household items. Can’t kick such a door down with just a single kick.
hideout_area_1_stage_3_description: An advanced Hideout security system which includes, in addition to an armored bunker door, a video surveillance camera, an intercom system, fire extinguishers, as well as special ties to increase the structural strength of walls and ceiling.
hideout_area_20_stage_1_description: Basic bitcoin farm of 10 units. Using the computing power of graphics cards, you can use the system to produce physical bitcoins.
hideout_area_20_stage_2_description: An improved bitcoin farm of 25 units. Using the computing power of graphics cards, you can use the system to produce physical bitcoins.
hideout_area_20_stage_3_description: Maximum size bitcoin farm for 50 units with water cooling. Using the computing power of graphics cards, you can use the system to produce physical bitcoins.
hideout_area_21_stage_1_description: Decoration of your harsh Hideout with string lights and a Christmas Tree. Let your home be more comfortable and festive at this difficult time for Tarkov.
hideout_area_22_stage_1_description: A piece of a wall with swollen paint. Nothing serious, but it might become a problem soon.
hideout_area_22_stage_2_description: A piece of wall with heavily swollen paint. Water is seeping from the wall. You definitely need to do something about it. Wipe the floor, maybe.
hideout_area_22_stage_3_description: A piece of wall with heavily swollen paint. Part of the paint fell off. Water is seeping from the wall. There seems to be something behind this wall.
hideout_area_22_stage_4_description: A wall with a hidden door. You don't know who made it and why, but to open it, you will need tools. Also, another wipe wouldn't hurt.
hideout_area_22_stage_5_description: The damaged part of the wall turned out to be an entrance to the old hidden room. There is nothing inside but rubbish and a dead body. It will take a lot of effort to put this room in shape.
hideout_area_22_stage_6_description: A tidied up entrance to the new room.
hideout_area_23_stage_0_description: A space equipped for a makeshift gym.
hideout_area_23_stage_1_description: A well-equipped gym to keep your body in good physical shape.
hideout_area_24_stage_0_description: A great place to install a weapon rack.
hideout_area_24_stage_1_description: A small weapon rack. Simplifies firearm storage and allows to display weapons in a fancy way.
hideout_area_24_stage_2_description: A medium-sized weapon rack. Simplifies firearm storage and allows to display weapons in a fancy way.
hideout_area_24_stage_3_description: A large weapon rack. Simplifies firearm storage and allows to display weapons in a fancy way.
hideout_area_26_stage_0_description: This place would be good to put a couple of mannequins found at the shopping malls. It just needs a little clean-up.
hideout_area_26_stage_1_description: A mannequin with a weapon rack. Allows you to prepare a set of equipment for the raid.
hideout_area_26_stage_2_description: With two mannequins, you can not only prepare gear for a raid, but also display something cool and rare. Would look great.
hideout_area_26_stage_3_description: Several mannequins with a weapon rack. With a wardrobe like this, it will be easy to store quick access gear for any occasion.
hideout_area_27_stage_0_description: A good place to meet the suspicious hooded persons. Although, you'll have to make contact with them first.
hideout_area_27_stage_1_description: A circle drawn in chalk and cluttered with mysterious symbols. Such circles are used by the cultists for their rituals. One wonders what would happen if you put something in the middle of it...?
hideout_area_2_stage_1_description: A primitive toilet. Any amenities are out of the question. Just a bucket and a litter box to maintain basic sanitation in the Hideout.
hideout_area_2_stage_2_description: A basic bathroom with a wooden outhouse type toilet and a washstand, connected to the water supply system. All this raises the level of cleanliness and hygiene in the Hideout.
hideout_area_2_stage_3_description: An advanced bathroom with a dry closet, a shower and a trash can. Everything you need is connected to the water supply system and provides the most affordable level of personal hygiene.
hideout_area_4_stage_1_description: A simple fuel generator that can provide basic Hideout equipment with electricity. The heart of your shelter. Fuel is needed to maintain the working power grid.
hideout_area_4_stage_2_description: A superior high power generator. It allows you to use a wider range of electrical appliances. Provides additional slots for installing fuel cans.
hideout_area_4_stage_3_description: Industrial generator to ensure the autonomous operation of production facilities. Also provides additional slots for installing fuel cans.
hideout_area_5_stage_1_description: A simple barrel with firewood to maintain heat. A very basic option for heating. Dangerous because of toxic carbon monoxide.
hideout_area_5_stage_2_description: A potbelly stove is a metal stove for interior heating, popular in the first half of the 20th century. An irreplaceable thing in the Hideout, especially when connected to the ventilation system for the output of combustion products.
hideout_area_5_stage_3_description: Equips the entire Hideout with additional electric heaters. Now, together with the potbelly stove, you won't be afraid of any cold.
hideout_area_6_stage_1_description: Basic water system for collecting groundwater. Contains several water filters and containers for water purification. One of the most important systems for maintaining life support in the Hideout.
hideout_area_6_stage_2_description: A sophisticated water collection system with additional pipes, filters, and larger containers. Installation of pumps allows to improve the pressure in the pipes and, consequently, the pressure of water.
hideout_area_6_stage_3_description: An advanced water collection system for both groundwater and rainwater. It contains various cleaning filters, an electric pump and an extensive water supply system throughout the Hideout. An additional filtration and enrichment system allows you to get very clean and high-quality water.
hideout_area_7_stage_1_description: The continued availability of medication means greater chances of survival after raids. Several medical storage boxes for basic medical care.
hideout_area_7_stage_2_description: A medical unit consisting of a table for medicine, a chair and a dropper. The healing process will be faster while you are out of raids.
hideout_area_7_stage_3_description: A full-fledged Hideout medical laboratory. It has everything you need to treat wounds, create medicines and maintain your good health during these difficult times.
hideout_area_8_stage_1_description: Food in the Hideout provides you with energy for future raids. A basic nutrition unit with an old fridge and a place to eat allows you to recover your energy faster.
hideout_area_8_stage_2_description: A nutrition unit with a more modern refrigerator, dining accessories, stove and sink, providing better food. Energy is restored faster.
hideout_area_8_stage_3_description: A full-fledged kitchen with a comfortable stove, an improved sink, an electric kettle, a microwave and everything necessary for fast and high-quality food cooking outside raids. Can’t violate the diet!
hideout_area_9_stage_1_description: Rest is very important, especially in the besieged Tarkov environment. A mattress over pallets is the very basic thing which can help PMCs relax after hard battles.
hideout_area_9_stage_2_description: A place to relax, equipped with a normal bed, bedside table and even an old TV. It creates a feeling of comfort and gives nostalgic memories of a former life.
hideout_area_9_stage_3_description: A lounge area with a sofa, an LCD TV with a Ployka Station console and a stereo system. It is hard to imagine that such comfort can be organized in an underground bunker when the whole world flies into the abyss.
hideoutmanagementdescription: Efficient Hideout management allows you to use less fuel and filters in production, and increases bonuses from different Hideout zones.
keeper_buy_08: Keep your eyes open on your way out.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_01: Who I am is not important at all at the moment. What matters is who you are and why you are here.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_02: I am Lightkeeper. I watch over everything and everyone, and all can see my light. In our restless time, it's critical to have the necessary information. Information creates connections, connections yield opportunities.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_03: Yes. The opportunity to change the surroundings and, as a consequence, the reality. In this kind of environment, the basic necessity for human beings is survival. I don't want to simply survive, I want to control the survival.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_04: It does, for the survivor. For someone who ensures survival, everything is different. We met for a reason. All events have a meaning, there are no accidents.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_05: But it was you who was looking for me, wasn’t it? Did you ask yourself why?
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_06: Being close to the one for whom the collapse is the beginning of the new. You don’t want to simply survive, you want to be in control.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_07: Tarkov is who you are. You cannot escape from yourself. Just as I could not escape from myself.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_08: This world is ending, all these pathetic attempts to hold on to a melting ice floe in the middle of a raging ocean - all these local fights, the hypocrisy of the traders, the instigation, violence multiplied by violence. All this leads to a very specific result. There will be no eclipse, there will be rebirth.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_09: You will not escape from Tarkov.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_10: You don’t understand, but this is natural. I didn't understand it at first either, when they reached out to me.
keeper_dialog_option_who_are_you_11: There's nothing more for us to talk about. In time, you'll figure it out for yourself, as you unravel the tangle.
keeper_first_greeting_01: Is that you? Right, who else would it be. So, you’ve passed all my tests? I am Lightkeeper. Guess you’ve heard about me. Everyone wants to do business with me, but not everyone can.
keeper_generic_farewell_03: That's all for now. Have a good one.
keeper_generic_farewell_05: I’ll be here if you need anything.
keeper_generic_farewell_06: Stop by when you get a minute.
keeper_generic_farewell_07: Good luck. Don’t make Zryachiy upset.
keeper_trade_02: Well, I do have something interesting.
keeper_trade_05: Here, just don’t waste my time.
keeper_want_work_reaction_01: Not now. The time will come.
keeper_want_work_reaction_02: We had only just got acquainted. Eventually, the time will come.
keeper_want_work_reaction_03: I'm working on something. Don't get ahead of yourself.
keeper_want_work_reaction_04: Any hour now. I’ll let you know when.
keeper_want_work_reaction_06: I'm not sure you are ready for this yet.

Тrading/Dialog/AvailableServices/Descrip: Want my services? Well, you've served your purpose already, so I'll help you — if you can pay me back.
54cb50c76803fa8b248b4571 Description: The Warrant officer in charge of supply warehouses on the sustaining base enforcing the Norvinsk region blockade. Secretly supplied the BEAR PMC operators with weapons, ammunition, and various other provisions he had at his disposal during the Contract Wars.
54cb57776803fa99248b456e Description: Head of the Trauma Care Department of the Tarkov Central City Hospital.
579dc571d53a0658a154fbec Location: A network of trading outlets all over the Norvinsk region
579dc571d53a0658a154fbec Description: The conflict had barely started when Fence began setting up anonymous outlets for buying and selling goods. Keeping incognito, he nevertheless managed to put together a well-organised smuggler network, operating all over the Norvinsk region.
58330581ace78e27b8b10cee Description: Previously a port zone customs terminal employee, who initially oversaw dealings of the terminal's goods. Over the course of the conflict, he put together a gang of thugs in order to grab everything of value that he could lay his hands on in the vicinity of the terminal.
5935c25fb3acc3127c3d8cd9 Description: UN peacekeeping Force supply officer, based in one of the central checkpoints leading to the Tarkov port zone. The blue helmets have been seen poking their heads into small deals from the very beginning of the conflict, buying everything of value in exchange for western weapons, ammo, and all kinds of military equipment.
5a7c2eca46aef81a7ca2145d Location: Chemical Plant Factory within the Customs District
5a7c2eca46aef81a7ca2145d Description: A former chemical plant foreman, who from the very beginning of the conflict took to weapon modification, repairs, and maintenance of complex equipment and technology. He prefers clandestine solo living and operates discreetly, while placing complicated and challenging tasks above all else.
5ac3b934156ae10c4430e83c Description: Previously, he worked as a director in a shopping center located in the suburbs of Tarkov. Now dealing in mostly clothing- and gear-related items, anywhere from sunglasses to body armor.
5c0647fdd443bc2504c2d371 Description: Before the conflict, he worked as a hunter in the Priozersk Natural Reserve under the State Hunting Service. A professional hunter and survival specialist. Even now, he still guards the reserve's hunting grounds from various aggressive individuals.
68fe15990f29ba3fdbba9d55 Description: A multi-function radio station with built-in cryptographic processor.

58fe0e2d86f774720e7a498d 0: What's up, soldier? Was it you who lost all the stuff on {location} at {time} {date}? Take it before I change my mind.
58fe0e2d86f774720e7a498d 1: Lost your gear, musketeer? Pfft, grab it Rambo. Your insured assets from {date} at {time} on {location} were brought in.
58fe0e2d86f774720e7a498d 2: Seems like the {date} raid on {location} went wrong, huh? I know it did, since my guys dragged your stuff in here. You taking it or what?
58fe0e2d86f774720e7a498d 3: Chin up, soldier! Your insurance worked, the one from {date} at {time} on {location}. Not everyone often gets this lucky!
58fe0e2d86f774720e7a498d 4: Oi, nerf gunner! Yeah, you. Had a feeling it's one of those days when packing up for {date} raid on {location}? You were right to get insured then. Take your stuff and sign on the dotted line.
58fe0e3486f77471f772c3f2 0: Mercenary, did you insure your possessions before the {date} raid at {time} on {location}? Your return.
58fe0e3486f77471f772c3f2 1: Young man, I'm not an expert in this equipment, but apparently these are your belongings. They were insured on {date} at {time} and brought back from {location}.
58fe0e3486f77471f772c3f2 2: It's good you came here! Some items were brought back according to your {date} insurance from {location}. They are not exactly my specialty, so please take care to retrieve them soon.
58fe0e3486f77471f772c3f2 3: Do you still care for your belongings, insured on {date} at {time}? Take them as soon as possible, then.
58fe0e3486f77471f772c3f2 4: Glad to see you in one piece. Your gear, insured on {date}, was brought back from {location}. Care to take it?
58fe0e3a86f774725a56b846 0: I reckon this might be yours, my guys found it on {location} on {date}.
58fe0e4586f774728248ca13 0: Hey, you! I've got some of your things that you insured on {date} at {time} and lost somewhere on {location}. Keep in mind I won't hold them forever, 24 hours at most!
58fe0e4586f774728248ca13 1: My dogs just pulled in a bunch of loot from {location}. Did you lose anything on {date} at {time}?
58fe0e4586f774728248ca13 2: Did you hear about the action on {location} sometime around {date} - {time}? Or perhaps you were there too? Anyhow, I've got plenty of interesting stuff from there. Take a look, some of it might even be yours. If not, I'll be putting it up for sale.
58fe0e4586f774728248ca13 3: I reckon this might be yours, my guys found it on {location} on {date}.
58fe0e4586f774728248ca13 4: I take it you had some misfortune on {date} on {location}? Lucky for you, my dogs found some of your gear.
59008bca86f7745cb11ae67b 0: Insurance from {date} at {time} complete. See you next time.
59008bca86f7745cb11ae67b 1: So? We good? See you later, I've got work to do.
59008bca86f7745cb11ae67b 2: Gonna close this insurance case that happened on {date} at {time}. Live long and stay alive, warrior.
59008bca86f7745cb11ae67b 3: Today is your lucky day, you were smart to insure your stuff. Grab it and I'll see you later.
59008bca86f7745cb11ae67b 4: It's a good thing you trusted your gut and insured your stuff with me, I've got it all right here for you. Insurance case closed.
59008bd186f77459395f4d63 0: Great. I'm closing the insurance case, the one was from {date} at {time}. I hope you've got everything you lost.

55f2d3fd4bdc2d5f408b4567 Description:
The industrial estate and facilities of Chemical Plant No. 16 were rented out illegally to the TerraGroup corporation. During the advent of the Contract Wars, the plant became the scene of numerous firefights between BEAR and USEC that ultimately determined control over the industrial district of Tarkov.

Later on, in the wake of the chaos, the plant facilities became a shelter for the remaining civilians, Scavs, and military operatives, including the scattered remains of the BEAR and USEC contingents.
56db0b3bd2720bb0678b4567 Description: A makeshift arena for gladiator fights, redesigned by remaining locals out of Equator-2 shopping mall.
56f40101d2720b2a4d8b45d6 Description: A large area of industrial park land situated adjacent to the factory zone. The area houses a customs terminal, fuel storage facilities, offices, and dorms, as well as a variety of other infrastructure and buildings.
5704e3c2d2720bac5b8b4567 Description: The Priozersk Nature Reserve recently became part of the state-protected wildlife reserves of the North-Western Federal District.
5704e47ed2720bb35b8b4568 Description: The Verkhneye urban settlement is a small town by the seaside, favoured by locals as an exceptional gardening and outdoor recreation spot.
5704e4dad2720bb55b8b4567 Description: The lighthouse at Cape Dalniy was an important strategic object on the way to Tarkov. During Contract Wars, it was the main entry point for USEC units and served as their base of operations. After the conflict, Scavs took a fancy to this place, until the old owners returned, who decided to stay in Tarkov and establish their own order.
5704e554d2720bac5b8b456e Description:
The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port.

The area houses a partially abandoned village, modern private housing, agricultural fields, long stretches of beach, a boating facility, gas station, weather station, and a cellular tower as well as other commercial facilities.

Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port.
5704e5a4d2720bb45b8b4567 Description: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.
5704e5fad2720bc05b8b4567 Description: The secret Federal State Reserve Agency base that, according to urban legends, contains enough supplies to last for years: food, medications, and other resources, enough to survive an all-out nuclear war.
5704e64ad2720bb55b8b456e Description: Private residential sector consisting of cottages of the upper-class citizens of Tarkov. In the first weeks of the emerging chaos, it served as a refugee staging camp but has since then become a known scavenger haunt.
5714dbc024597771384a510d Description: The South Interchange is a key transport location for the city. This strategic area connects the port and harbor with the industrial outskirts of Tarkov. Located in the center of the interchange is a huge ULTRA shopping mall which was used as the main base of operation for the EMERCOM evacuation.
5714dc342459777137212e0b Description: The suburb and commuter areas of Tarkov containing all the infrastructure and creature comforts needed for a long and happy life.
5714dc692459777137212e12 Description: Downtown Tarkov houses banks, malls, and hotels, as well as all the other amenities a thriving metropolis could have needed.
599319c986f7740dca3070a6 Description: A makeshift gladiator-style arena, redesigned by the remaining locals out of the Equator-2 shopping mall.
