In 2004, an agent of TerraGroup International Holding made contact with USEC, which then consecutively made USEC, essentially, a private army of the holding, with offices all around the world, and over 7500 staff strong.
5464e0454bdc2d06708b4567 Description: The BEAR private military company was established by a secret decree of the Russian Federation Government as a countermeasure against the illegal activities of TerraGroup on Russian soil.
5803a58524597710ca36fcb2 Description: TerraGroup is a transnational holding company whose subsidiaries engage in a wide range of activities. TG incorporates over 40 large enterprises, represented by branch offices in over 120 countries.
5805f617245977100b2c1f41 Description: A UK-based private limited company (PLC) and a subsidiary of the TerraGroup International Holding corporation. Officially deals in scientific research concerning biotechnology applied in agribusiness industry and farming.
5807be8924597742c603fa19 Description: Tarkov is a city in northwestern Russia, a municipal entity within the Norvinsk region, and one of two principal cities of the Norvinsk Special Economic Zone.
5807bfe124597742a92e0a4c Description: A limited territory within the Norvinsk region, including the cities of Norvinsk and Tarkov, with adherent objects of infrastructure, possessing a special legal status in relation to the rest of Russia, a privileged economic zone for national and foreign enterprises.
5807c3f124597746bf2db2ce Description: Amidst the chaos and lawlessness, scarcity of vital provisions, and territory, the first to lift up their heads are shady characters, unaffected by excessive moral or ethical restraints, or who are quick to lose them under hostile influences and conditions. They gather in packs, live by dog-eat-dog rules, and cut each other's throats for a bigger piece. This is how yesterday's civilians became Scavs.
5c1b857086f77465f465faa4 Description: A shady group of armed people who, according to rumors, consist of former PMC operators and local residents. They possess great combat and tactical skills.
63a9c1f5662a5b0a2c7fbde5 Description: Tarkov is a city in northwestern Russia, a municipal entity within the Norvinsk region, and one of two principal cities of the Norvinsk Special Economic Zone.
64c0acf85174e095610734a0 Description: Sherpas are players who help beginners study the main game features and improve their skills to survive the harsh Tarkov environment. This difficult and honorable task falls on the shoulders of the most friendly, patient, and experienced players.
64c0ad6af99768b777048f4e Description: Emissaries are volunteers from all over the world who are actively involved in the Escape from Tarkov community and support Battlestate Games. Emissaries create content, make sure every voice in the community is heard, and make official messages clear and accessible to players anywhere in the world.
6724cde3b1130abeee0c3db7 Description: Rumors have spread around Tarkov about a leak from the TerraGroup Laboratory. Residents affected by the substance have shown sudden changes in behavior and bouts of aggression. The number of casualties is rapidly increasing. With this new threat endangering the entire city, conflicts between the factions in Tarkov have significantly decreased. It's possible that the leaders of each side have agreed to a temporary truce.
67d135bc9e0d93daf71d555e Description: A large area of industrial park land situated adjacent to the factory zone. The area houses a customs terminal, fuel storage facilities, offices, and dorms, as well as a variety of other infrastructure and buildings.
67d13656443d3073a3a92427 Description: The industrial estate and facilities of Chemical Plant No. 16 (Polikhim) were rented out illegally to the TerraGroup corporation. During the advent of the Contract Wars, the plant became the scene of numerous firefights between BEAR and USEC that ultimately determined control over the industrial district of Tarkov.
67d1abc6c5fbfe1a95025e93 Description: The South Interchange is a key transport location for the city. This strategic area connects the port and harbor with the industrial outskirts of Tarkov. Located in the center of the interchange is a huge ULTRA shopping mall which was used as the main base of operation for the EMERCOM evacuation.
67d1ac1a2fb6a5d11b09d6f8 Description: The lighthouse at Cape Dalniy was an important strategic object on the way to Tarkov. During Contract Wars, it was the main entry point for USEC units and served as their base of operations. After the conflict, Scavs took a fancy to this place, until the old owners returned, who decided to stay in Tarkov and establish their own order.
67d1ac705df2d64de808e1d2 Description: The secret Federal State Reserve Agency base that, according to urban legends, contains enough supplies to last for years: food, medications, and other resources, enough to survive an all-out nuclear war.
67d1ac822b87c1a5a30e5ae8 Description: The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began.
67d1ac995df2d64de808e1d6 Description:
The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port.

The area houses a partially abandoned village, modern private housing, agricultural fields, long stretches of beach, a boating facility, gas station, weather station, and a cellular tower as well as other commercial facilities.

Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port.
67d1acbf5df2d64de808e1d8 Description: Downtown Tarkov houses banks, malls, and hotels, as well as all the other amenities a thriving metropolis could have needed.
67d1acda2fb6a5d11b09d6fd Description: The Priozersk Nature Reserve recently became part of the state-protected wildlife reserves of the North-Western Federal District.
67d1ad1b5df2d64de808e1da Description: Secret underground TerraGroup Labs facility hidden right under the center of Tarkov. Officially, this research center does not exist and, based on data scraps, is engaged in research and development as well as testing and simulation of projects in chemistry, physics, biology, and other high technology.
67e3f71e445e18765a052687 Description: A facility of one of TerraGroup's contractors, Knossos LLC. According to public sources, they build amusement and theme parks. However, this place looks more like a heavily fortified bunker than a new theme park.
67e3f72fdb783364cd0a4b63 Description: There are rumors of a maniac who calls himself the Shadow of Tagilla. Anybody can become a victim of his tortures, and no one has ever escaped from his Labyrinth. One question remains: where did the rumors come from then?
67e41856bf56c419c2861a2c Description: A facility of one of TerraGroup's contractors, Knossos LLC. According to public sources, they build amusement and theme parks. However, this place looks more like a heavily fortified bunker than a new theme park.
67e41856bf56c419c2861a30 Description: There are rumors of a maniac who calls himself the Shadow of Tagilla. Anybody can become a victim of his tortures, and no one has ever escaped from his Labyrinth. One question remains: where did the rumors come from then?
67f1acb2798033628e4c618c Description:
You passed the test mate, and I'm keeping my word. Ref's ready to meet you.
Reward: You have unlocked access to trader Ref!
67f1adea657637a74150c2ea Description:
I said I'd set you up with Jaeger, didn’t I? Everything's arranged. Now you can go talk to him.
Reward: You have unlocked access to trader Jaeger!
67f1b1f11b4b4b2dddbefabb Name: Escape from Tarkov: Arena free trial
67f1b1f11b4b4b2dddbefabb Description:
Some special people put in a good word for you. They say you're a perfect merc for the Arena. So come, test your strength with Tarkov's finest gladiators!
Reward: Access to Escape from Tarkov: Arena for 3 days!
6901f52709598eae190be134 Description: The southern port Terminal has been under Russian Armed Forces control since the beginning of the Tarkov conflict. After the city was sealed off, the terminal was fortified and became the primary evacuation point, sought by both civilian refugees and PMC units. According to unconfirmed reports, TerraGroup personnel were also evacuated through this port.
69d3664a12d9cc10ef536e85 Description: Got something to discuss about those masks from previous seasons. Best hold onto them for me.
69d36a4d9d5aa82932e3fadd Description: Got a little side job for you with those Arena masks. So don’t go handing them off to anyone else, yeah? Bring them straight to me instead.
6a0512aaf7fb4f27bdd22496 Description: The components you intercepted from the Rogues have proven very useful across my facilities. Can you source more? The compensation will match your contribution, don’t worry.
6a05138dafb6c60e083e1c33 Description: The maps you brought back from the Rogues didn’t just mark that strange object in the gulf, they also show Rogue positions and movement routes!  I understand it’s unlikely you’ll come across another full set like that. But if you do find anything similar, I’m prepared to pay well for it.
6a0af619a152ae5646008b68 Description:
In the Gulf of Finland, trapped within the blockade surrounding Tarkov, lies the nuclear-powered icebreaker "Boreas", owned by the logistics corporation Paradigm Shipping. The exact purpose of "Boreas" and the cargo it carries remain unknown. 

It appears that Paradigm Shipping and TerraGroup made special efforts to minimize any mention of the icebreaker in the press and keep its routes and assignments classified.
6a0af633921cc16e0f0055ef Description:
From time to time, rumors spread through Tarkov about a special unit that belongs neither to USEC nor BEAR. According to campfire stories, these special operatives conduct night-time operations to clear restricted facilities and extract valuable TerraGroup data.

But among PMC operators, very few believe in the existence of this so-called “Black Division”, because under the current circumstances, freely inserting and extracting entire combat groups through the blockade ring is practically impossible.
6a609ac4f58fcc8978057b75 Description:
Even Scavs have their own code. Fence makes sure it's respected, and he can make life very difficult for anyone who chooses to ignore it.

The first and most important rule – Scavs don't shoot their own!
At least not first.
6a609acf5cc248b1670be7aa Description:
A high reputation with Fence lets you play as a Scav more often, gives your Scav better gear and more extraction points, and unlocks many other benefits.

To increase your Fence reputation, complete his tasks, use vehicle and co-op extractions, successfully extract from raids, and eliminate hostile PMCs while playing as a Scav.

Eyewitnesses remaining in the city report increasing clashes between BEAR and USEC units. UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces are cordoning off dangerous areas, but these zones are growing, and according to unconfirmed reports, high-level discussions are already underway regarding a potential full lockdown of the city. Both PMC groups likely still maintain their supply channels for weapons and personnel, which is why almost no one is willing to make optimistic forecasts. Evacuation of civilians is difficult, and both sides are organizing humanitarian aid drops to help local residents hold out until safe corridors open. Amid the crisis, local criminal groups are also becoming more active. In some cases, these groups manage to seize weapons and take control of parts of the city. Currently, three such areas are known. In the city center, the criminal gang of a former entrepreneur, known by the alias "Kaban", has established a fortified base in the former LexOs car dealership. According to recent data, PMC units have unsuccessfully attempted to dislodge the gang several times. An anonymous source told the editorial team that Kaban possesses samples of heavy weaponry that cannot even be obtained on the black market. Some experts suggest a possible connection between Kaban and the nonprofit organization "Forward Movement", which was previously linked in a high-profile case involving deputy minister of economy Yaroslav Shkurenko and the criminal authority nicknamed Chepyga. Near the customs terminal, the "Zavodskoy" gang, previously involved in petty thefts in the district, has been spotted. Eyewitnesses report ongoing gunfire in that area. EMERCOM units were forced to abandon evacuation points near the "Ultra" mall due to increased attacks by armed groups that took control of one floor of the mall. EMERCOM tents at the nearby highway interchange are no longer safe. EMERCOM recommendations remain the same: first, find a secure shelter and wait for evacuation there, provide aid to the wounded if possible, and avoid venturing onto city streets. We hope that UN forces and the Russian Armed Forces will take more decisive measures to cool the conflict in Tarkov and will continue reporting all important developments. ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ HUMANITARIAN AID POINTS BY TARKOV DISTRICTS Komsomolsky District Ordzhonikidze Ave, 3. 689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page1_Text:
<width=70%>And then the Riders of the Arrival shall appear, and they shall open the door to the New World. All that is old shall die, for only the devoted flock is worthy of transformation and service to The Unheard.

The Wardens shall reap the harvest and carry into the New World the memory of old humanity. The transition to the next stage of evolution is inevitable, and the appearance of the Riders marks the beginning of the division of homo sapiens into two kinds.

They shall no longer be united: each shall be shown their place. Only those among us who follow the path laid out by The Unheard shall be permitted to witness the true flourishing of civilization.

For Their enlightenment is our salvation, and only by Their wisdom can the New World be governed.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


In the decisive hour, the Riders of the Arrival shall emerge from the shadows of corporations and states, yet they shall neither seek aid nor call followers. For we must see the great design ourselves, we must bring an end
to the old world so that from its ashes the New may be born.

Before the face of the coming, fear will compel many to submit to the will of new rulers. But the Rider cannot be deceived. The wisest judgment shall separate the wheat from the chaff, and each shall be repaid according to their deeds. The old truths have long lost their meaning. Only one truth and one purpose remain steadfast amid the ashes of dead ideas – to hasten the birth of the New World and prepare everything for the Great Arrival.</width>
689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page3_Text:
<width=70%>Sunset and dawn, fall and uprising demand Sacrifice! Not become a Sacrifice, but become the executioner’s sword! The weak will perish, and the strong will perish! Only the truly faithful will be allowed to the Door into the future. There, where neurons and bits become one whole.

The Door, the Door, the Door divides past and future, it separates the New and the old world! By the hand of The Unheard it will open, and it will cut away all that is old, all that is needless… The will of The Unheard will determine a new order in which the human species will enter a new phase of development. Phoenix! Rebirth through blood! The new human needs fresh blood!

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


Thoughts do not burn, the thoughts of Man will remain forever and the Wardens will carry thoughts through the purifying flame of true faith! The Old Man will die. The gods will die. <u>Knowledge will live</u>. Knowledge is more important than the heart! More important than blood!

The pinnacle of evolution turned out to be only a step on the path of humanity’s development, all for the sake of the truth that will be revealed to The Unheard! In the name of truth, kill. The truly faithful understand, the others will burn. The others are destined for pain. All who are not ready to be reborn will drown in the fire of pain. The final threshold. Transformation. 689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page5_Text:
<width=70%>The Priests have access to fragments of The Unheard Knowledge, for they have seen what will be. It was said that the Blue Fire will illuminate our world with a new dawn, and this will be the Dawn of the New World, and then the sacred flame of each was illuminated. The old idols, which humanity followed, lost their former power, and a new order began. The blind burn in the fire of suffering, as foretold, for they do not know the True Path. But the truly faithful turned to the Warden and were promised salvation, for the New Family awaits the New World.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲

Only Truth will govern the New World, and in its fire, all who cannot grasp it will be consumed. People of the old world see only suffering, but the enlightened see the path and salvation. The blind have turned away from the dawn of the New World, as foretold. 689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page6_Text:
<width=70%>The truly faithful must follow the Path shown by The Unheard. For anyone can hasten the Arrival. The products of human thought must be gathered in special places, marked by the devoted.

The birth of the New World is preceded by the death of the old. And for this death to occur, The Unheard need instruments through which the great purification of the human race will take place.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


But the devoted themselves can become the sword that cleaves a path to the New World. By separating the truly faithful from the doomed, even now we can help The Unheard cleanse the old world. The spilled blood of the blind must become a sign from which others will awaken.

Faith is proven only through blood, pain is the touch of The Unheard, blissful and searing, for only through fire can a mortal be reborn, only with flame is the dead burned away! With Blue Fire! The flame will divide all, the flame will reveal everything, and it will reveal the New World.</width>
689b53222c175da5bf083ba3_Note_Page8_Text:
<width=70%>For those initiated into the plan, The Unheard have prepared a special and singular Path, along which the chosen will be able to enter the New World. Rebirth is ordained for our species, and every new step toward the coming future is marked by the <u>Gift</u>. Each Gift is destined to play its role.

The <u>Blue Fire</u> will become the fire that ignites the entire old world. Dry and dead, the old world must burn to ashes. States will fall, unable to resist the inevitable march of time. The power of rulers will prove to be their curse, for there is no power greater than the power of <s>The Unheard</s> wisdom, and no wisdom higher than the wisdom of The Unheard.

Yet the pinnacle of homo sapien’ history must become the foundation of the New World. All information available to humanity will be sifted through the sieve of the Wardens. Every thought and every action committed by a human will become a cast of the homo sapiens species, for nothing will escape the <u>Eye of the World</u>.

 ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲


The best that sapiens will leave behind are the pinnacles of thought, which will outlast both this species and this world. Knowledge gave rise to it, and it will also be the engine that will launch a new rebirth. But this time, living thought is destined to become one with artificial thought. True rebirth is a transformation and a merging with a more efficient <u>Higher Mind</u>.

Humanity is incapable, in the truest sense, of mastering time and space. But that which will follow homo sapiens will overcome this limitation as well, for the wisdom of The Unheard will pave the way to the <u>Door</u>, beyond which awaits the New World and the answers to all questions. BLOOD.</width>

689b53b7127673bbd40706d3_Note_Page1_Text: Lights of Tarkov Your daily source of information ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ – According to our information, Cobalt has been facing difficulties integrating into Tarkov’s energy infrastructure. Is that true? – I wouldn’t put it that way. Yes, innovation requires significant energy resources, and our facilities are no exception. Some of our projects demand power plants that simply don’t exist in the region. But the company’s development strategy already includes the construction of next-generation power stations. And we’ve made progress – just two days ago we, hm, reached an agreement with Yaroslav Grigorievich! (editor’s note: Deputy Minister of Economy Shkurenko Y. G.) In the future, Cobalt will bring light to many citizens of Tarkov, and today’s difficulties have only highlighted a problem in the city that we intend to solve. – So you see the problem as lying with the city, not the costs of your projects? Our data suggests Tarkov has never suffered from a power shortage. – Are you asking whether our projects can improve the city’s situation? That’s a great question! And I’ll say this: one of the key reasons for choosing this site was its potential for developing energy infrastructure, and in that regard, Tarkov certainly has room to grow. You have to understand – it’s not about what Tarkov looks like now, it’s about what it will become with us. – Speaking of innovation. We’ve calculated that even taken together, all of Cobalt’s public projects don’t consume that much electricity. It seems Cobalt is planning to increase the city’s power load several times over for a project the people of Tarkov know nothing about. How do you comment on that? – We understand the public’s concern and appreciate the interest in our work! But right now, even a small leak could seriously affect the development process. The walls have ears, right? Too much openness could harm not only Cobalt, but also Russia’s position on the international market. But getting back to Tarkov and its energy infrastructure – we’ve already reached a compromise with the local authorities. Until our new plants are operational, we’ll be "staying over" at state-owned facilities. For now, we’ll have to squeeze into city power plant buildings, but once our stations come online, the people of Tarkov will forget about power shortages entirely. – Well, we’re intrigued by Cobalt’s new project and look forward to hearing more. This has been Yuri Belogorov from Lights of Tarkov, and Nikolay Tretyakov, NGO Cobalt representative in Tarkov.

The list of permitted protocols may be expanded. The ARRS system is fully autonomous and can operate without external power sources, including under protocol Twilight. If an ARRS agent is disconnected from the network, each module can continue recording for up to 2 years and retain stored data for up to 10 years. The system supports expansion with additional ARRS modules and automatic updates. Each ARRS module is equipped with a unique security system (MOU-73S) capable of completely locking the module. Access to a module is possible only with a unique identifier embedded in the senior operator’s key. GENERAL DESIGN The ARRS system has no single control center. Each ARRS module locally stores the following data: 1) Scripts required for the module’s autonomous operation 2) Scripts for verifying user access level and transmitting data according to protocol The Eye (HGL-01E) 3) Archive of recordings for the entire observation history 4) Scripts to initiate protocol Warden (JKL-13R) Module preparation and assembly are carried out according to the instructions described in Appendix 17 (TUR-09L). 68d2f400be7c1493b90cd3f7_Note_Page1_Text: #14 Newspaper THE NINTH CIRCLE ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ The Will of Chance Greetings to all survivors. I don’t know what I’d do without being able to talk to you. Sometimes it even feels like the old world never existed, as if everything collapsed into this closed-off city where each of us has just one mission – to make it through to tomorrow. But today, I want to share a story that gives me hope for a better outcome. Maybe it will help you too. Yesterday I went to check on a wounded friend and met a gloomy, withdrawn BEAR sitting in Therapist’s recovery room, clutching a USEC patch in his hands. At first glance, it seemed obvious: a trophy from a heavy fight where he lost a comrade. He’d avenged him, sure, but that hadn’t brought him peace. So there he sat, angry at himself for not being able to double-tap that USEC in time. Still, I decided to strike up a conversation, and from his first words, I realized all my guesses were wrong. This BEAR had been scouting a new route to TerraGroup’s underground lab when his squad discovered an elevator shaft in critical condition. They managed to reach the complex through it and complete their mission, but on the way back, Raiders pinned them down hard. During the retreat, the shaft collapsed, burying the entire team except for our guy. He himself was pinned against a wall by a support beam. The surface was just a couple hundred meters away, but without help, he had no chance of making it out alive. So he decided to hold on as long as he could. Two days later, he heard footsteps approaching. He recognized English speech, but by then he couldn’t even hold his pistol, let alone put up a fight. He saw a flashlight beam sweep the tunnel ahead and braced himself for the end. But instead of a gunshot, he heard a safety click, followed by careful steps. The newcomer wasn’t an enemy, but an ally. The stranger helped him get free, but the effort triggered heavy bleeding that his exhausted body couldn’t handle. What happened next he remembers only in fragments, drifting in and out of consciousness. All his strength went into holding onto that USEC, and at some point, he accidentally tore the patch off the stranger’s shoulder. He woke up in Therapist’s care, never finding out who had pulled him from the rubble. All he had left was the patch, which he now keeps with him. We often convince ourselves that we’re in control, but most things around us are shaped by forces we can’t predict – a lucky weather break during retreat, a weapon jam in the enemy’s hands, or the will of a random passerby. To everyone reading this: I wish you hope for a better outcome, even when everything seems set against you. That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.
68d2f44df63f06b7590ce30e_Note_Page1_Text: #19 Newspaper THE NINTH CIRCLE ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ ̲ Down the Untrodden Paths I welcome my readers once again. The Contract Wars have forever changed Tarkov’s landscape, and knowing the terrain often means the difference between life and death. Many turn to Jaeger for help, but the forester’s experience is of little use in urban areas or on the outskirts. Some of you may have heard of the Mushroom Picker who roams across the city, though few have ever met him in person. At one point, both the military and the Scavs were hunting the reclusive old man. It’s said the Mushroom Picker has no ties to TerraGroup and has never even held a weapon. Still, many would pay a fortune to have him on their side. That’s because the old man knows routes and passages that no one has walked, even in peaceful times. Somehow, the Mushroom Picker manages to avoid army checkpoints, not to mention Scav camps. With knowledge like that, he can seriously affect the balance of power in Tarkov. Yet no one has ever truly understood his motives or goals. The more devout citizens like to tell stories of his night-time encounters with witnesses of the Arrival. To be honest, I don’t rule anything out anymore. Despite his murky nature, the Mushroom Picker sometimes appears to those who’ve lost their way. I personally know several people, and they share nothing in common: he’s helped mercenaries from both PMCs, civilians, and even Scavs. Whatever moral compass guides this eccentric wanderer, his help is not something one can count on. A meeting with the Mushroom Picker only happens when he wills it. That’s all for now. Stay alive till tomorrow.

During the reporting period 14 groups of test subjects were examined at the site. Each group contained between 5 and 25 people depending on the experimental conditions. Some experiments could not be carried out due to the site’s limited capabilities. Group 9 was redirected to Site Theta because of the risk of contamination and the poor containment of the “Labyrinth” premises. Group 1 had to be neutralized entirely for similar reasons. Studies were conducted on effects on the human body and on expanding physical capabilities. Work proceeded along three directions: 1) Increasing organism endurance under various conditions. 2) Testing the effects of experimental biological compounds on the human body. 3) Developing compounds capable of affecting the human mental state. Increasing organism endurance under various conditions. During the study, subjects were placed in various conditions (food deprivation, prolonged confinement in a restricted space, blood loss exceeding 20/30/40% of total blood volume, burns with ITP from 50 to 95 points, acute and subacute intoxication). Compounds SJ6, eTG-c, and SJ1 demonstrated significant effectiveness in stabilizing condition and activating the organism’s reserve resources in poisoning of varying severity and intoxication in the presence of open wounds. Compounds SJ15 and M.U.L.E. demonstrated high effectiveness under favorable conditions and increased subjects’ activity periods by 47–60%. As a result of the studies, eTG-c, SJ6, and SJ15 are recommended for further iteration and development. The lack of professional training among test subjects negatively affected research results, therefore when used on trained combat personnel, the projected effect may reach higher results. Field testing is required.

Extensive testing of already developed combat stimulants was carried out according to the established plan. Compounds P22 and M.U.L.E. exhibited critical side effects with regular use. Subjects were diagnosed with muscle tissue atrophy and, in isolated cases, paralysis or necrosis of individual muscles (3% of subjects). The research group associates these effects with excessive wear of muscle tissue and the organism’s inability to recover after such pressure. It is recommended to develop an advanced version of these compounds in which, after administration of the functional composition, a restorative mixture is also administered to replace expended physiological resources. Development of a new formulation of the compound Zagustin continues. Formulations that thinned the blood immediately after the action of the primary mixture were tested, but subjects exhibited symptoms similar to hemophilia. None of these subjects had a genetic predisposition to hemophilia, therefore the search for a more suitable formulation continues. In parallel a Zagustin-based compound with reduced effect on profibrinolysin activators is being developed. <width=75%><size=20>Apr. 14: The Bogatyr group intercepted intel on an upcoming USEC operation to evacuate a TerraGroup informant using surface vessels in the Gulf of Finland, near Vidny Island.

The group’s commander, callsign Voevoda, decided to intercept the target on his own initiative. In his personal report, Voevoda justified the decision by citing a lack of time for coordination and preparation of an official strike team.

The Bogatyrs set up an ambush near an abandoned barge by Vidny Island and successfully captured the informant. The enemy was eliminated with no casualties on the Bogatyr side. The informant was later extracted to the handoff point for a BEAR reserve unit.</size></width>
68d302814aae290cf704e375_Note_Page2_Text:
<width=75%><size=20>Mar. 25 - Mar. 27: The Bogatyr squad was assigned to locate and extract a TerraGroup asset. The target was not found at the designated coordinates, and due to radio silence, it was impossible to coordinate further actions with command.

According to the plan, the group was to withdraw and report mission failure. However, the commander (callsign Voevoda) chose to continue the search and successfully identified the asset’s new location.

From Mar. 26 to Mar. 27, the Bogatyr squad conducted surveillance on the convoy transporting the target and prepared for an assault. On Mar. 27, the asset was captured. The group then relocated and established a comms point to file the report. The commander confirmed multiple wounded and one KIA. Enemy forces were neutralized, and the asset was handed over to headquarters on Mar. 29.</size></width>
68d3037c91c2fa84e2044a0d_Note_Page1_Text:
<width=65%><align="center">Report</align>

On Jan. 2, the Bogatyr squad carried out a hostage evacuation from the Tarbank branch on Korablestroiteley Street. The enemy had taken up firing positions on the 1st and 2nd floors. Hostages were sheltered in the reception area on the 1st floor.

A direct assault was ruled out to minimize risk to the hostages. I decided to clear the building with two teams. The first team (call signs: Moreman, Kaskad) ascended to the 2nd floor using climbing gear and engaged the enemy utilizing smoke grenades.

Meanwhile, the main assault team (call signs: Voevoda, Taran, Vityaz), under sniper overwatch (call sign: Strelets), attacked the enemy on the 1st floor and extracted the hostages. The operation was completed swiftly, no hostages were injured. Fourteen targets were neutralized, presumably members of Kaban's criminal gang. No casualties in the Bogatyr squad.

The operation drew attention from nearby USEC forces and local civilians, and the squad had to repel enemy attacks twice during the withdrawal. After handing over the freed hostages to Russian Armed Forces, the Bogatyr squad will relocate from its previous bases to the Carousel outpost to await further instructions.

69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page1_Text: 12.11. Got out of Stockholm without any trouble. But during the layover the whole place turned into a complete fucking shitshow. Not only did they pull the entire crew off the ship and slow all work onboard to a crawl, they wouldn’t even let us stand nearby. And for what? With paranoia like that no wonder Terragroup rotates crews on the icebreaker so often. Short-ass contracts, all these fucked protocols, all this secrecy bullshit… nobody’d put up with this crap if the pay wasn’t insane. And I even managed to sneak a look at the loading op. They got people running back and forth nonstop and all they’re loading is crates full of electronics. Even the dockworkers are their own guys. Nobody GIVES A FUCK about your electronics, we’ve carried worse at sea! Arrogant fucking asshole fucks. 20.11 Made it to Tarkov, which means Saint Petersburg’s close now. Just hope we don’t get stuck here too like we did in Stockholm. Almost home.
69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page2_Text: 09.12 Wow what great fucking luck. They delayed the stopover while we were already approaching Tarkov, then canceled the whole thing completely. Heard something serious happened with Terragroup in the city, maybe even a shootout or some shit. If even half of it’s true, we’re gonna be sitting here for a long damn time. 15.01 Knew right away this was going to turn into a disaster… We’re fucked, royally. Orders came down from above to drop anchor and wait for further instructions and meanwhile everything in Tarkov just keeps getting worse. Alex says UN troops’ll enter the city soon and everything’ll calm down. Yeah, sure. Fucking sure it will… 3.06 Still no orders. Comms started acting up too. Usually at least you know when your contract ends, but here you just sit around losing your damn mind. Max’s family in Tarkov saw military vehicles in the streets. Maybe our guys’ll finally get shit under control??
69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page3_Text: April Thought I’d never even find this notebook again. And sure as hell never thought I’d end up trapped on this goddamn icebreaker for years. Fucking blockade… And that bastard Altman deserves worse than death! Yes the boys broke. We should’ve called for evacuation a long damn time ago! Maybe a year back those USECs still could’ve smuggled us across the cordon. Obvious enough command stopped giving a shit about us the second troops rolled into the city. But no. Altman’s precious materials matter more than actual living people whose brains are already melting in this frozen hell!
69bb4558b44453acde02ebe7_Note_Page4_Text:
<width=70%><size=22>And the captain’s no better, completely lost his fucking mind over somebody breaking radio silence…

At least now there’s maybe some hope they’ll get us outta here. And when we finally make it out I’m burning this fucking diary to ashes.</size></width>

69bb45b89c92ecd910059159_Note_Page4_Text: VEIL (Vectorized Exo-atmospheric Intelligence Lattice) Satellite Network Readiness The project to establish the VEIL orbital satellite network has reached its final construction stage. Integration of the satellites in the Lambda sector completed the orbital network, providing full coverage of the northern regions of Europe and Asia as well as the entire territories of both American continents. Despite the project nearing completion, the suspension of TerraGroup’s public humanitarian and scientific programs, as well as those of its subsidiaries related to ground and orbital network infrastructure, is not recommended. At this stage it is essential to minimize external attention from government authorities and the press. I recommend continuing all projects regardless of the cost of these investments. All associated expenses will be included in the VEIL project budget. In its current configuration, the VEIL system allows interception of signals across its entire coverage area and their seamless substitution, as well as the ability to simulate transmissions from specific senders, including government agencies of individual countries. In most sectors it is also possible to temporarily suppress any communications systems. (Satellites in the Upsilon and Delta sectors are still undergoing modernization and currently do not provide this capability.) Separately addressing the concerns raised by Ms. McRory: detection of the network by external means is practically impossible due to our modernization of the satellite hardware and the integration of officially decommissioned satellites into the network. Intelligence methods can only detect fragmented satellite coverage belonging to TerraGroup, which is insufficient to raise suspicion among journalists or intelligence services. Potential risks are associated only with TerraGroup’s public activities, particularly their abrupt termination or deviations from declared plans for public scientific and humanitarian projects. Integration of the ARRS network with VEIL is proceeding according to schedule. Only final testing remains, after which system access and control of VEIL via ARRS terminals will be possible using the appropriate access codes. Access codes will be distributed individually through the VEIL system. Immediately after full deployment, the project’s scientific team will be reassigned to the development of the first prototypes of incoherent wireless transmission (IWT) equipment. P. Wilson

6913325c3ae414e88e5a2460: Soldier: Over here! This way! We are leaving!
6913325cddc84f8c4a5698fe: Soldier: Looks like it’s quieted down. You can wait outside if you want.
6913325cf320cc1b1f1b9ecf: Soldier: Who knows when you’ll see Tarkov again. We’re leaving in one minute.
6913325ddca1b106f00a2208: Soldier: After that, head into the compartment, no roaming around the ship!
6911d01346e797a1aed776e3: Soldier: Over here! This way! We are leaving!

691332c5dbe53d46fc52cb05: TerraGroup Scientist: So, you made it. Managed to secure yourself a way out of Tarkov.
691332c5fbc5a5433dbb5cab: Soldier: Keep it quick, we could take fire from the port.
691332c67ec5c8fbd6555d21: TerraGroup Scientist: Not that it matters anymore.

691332c6ec3ba64108eb06a0: TerraGroup Scientist: What I fail to see is why you refused to help Kerman recover our secrets.
691332c732a1fcde7834180d: TerraGroup Scientist: Now, no one will ever find it.
691332c73feda8c9d2f75bc4: TerraGroup Scientist: Thanks to you, the documents remain buried in the city.
691332c792d084e5358c9ff7: TerraGroup Scientist: But surely you understand that your knowledge alone makes this problematic.
69137ef2090f71bfb27eafe3: Soldier: Then get inside, you could catch a stray bullet out here. It’d be a shame if after all this you got killed.
69137ef29575d687b965feb4: Soldier: Time to get out of here!

69137ef5fae526ef6eb04eb6: Operative: No time to deal with you. Lightkeeper’s instructions are in the envelope.
691333665750c2ea493460b8: Soldier: Time to get out of here!

691333678b28a4841f5f18b2: Soldier: Better head inside, don't want you catching a stray bullet from the port.
69133367cbc470c5f87f97ba: Captain: Lock up behind me. Let nobody in and nobody out. Do it!

6913336846ad76c43f0dcd29: Captain: Even you could have survived had you not dug into our secrets.
6913336872940925c302777b: Captain: You just don’t get it. If it weren’t for us, humanity would have long since died out.
691333695ca25aff6972cc5a: Soldier: Kerman didn’t want your docs intercepted. Want a smoke?
69133369a6fd369e6707ef51: Soldier: Relax. Only friendlies on board now.
6913336a5d9c3c23173ba1f2: Soldier: Holy shit! We got out just in time!
6913336a64c583bb571e2603: Soldier: What matters is we're alive, and now we’ll take down those bastards from TerraGroup.
6913336aab4be534634b7927: Soldier: The whole world will know the truth!
6913336ae25211ec81627d80: Soldier: By the way, take this! A souvenir.
6913336b59a882215703cb63: Soldier: Those fucks treat us like cattle… want to control us…
6913336c54c6e32fe80e7f59: Soldier: From here on, we decide our own fate.
69283ede2a5132b6f356198a: Captain: That The Unheard would let you go?

* The voice pack is purchased for both character factions (BEAR and USEC). If the voice pack is already activated for one faction, purchasing it will automatically unlock it for the other faction as well.

● Purchase is bound to the account and remains available after character wipes.

offer.6a68bb5be6af0052662f968a.descripti:
Resets your current seasonal character's progress and allows you to create a new character with a fresh selection of modifiers.

Seasonal Character Wipe is the complete and irreversible reset of a seasonal character's progress. Once applied, all of the character's items, equipment, currency, completed quests, leveled skills, and all other season progress will be permanently deleted, with the exception of earned in-game achievements.

The seasonal character will be restored to its initial state, corresponding to the bonuses and items included with your current edition of the game. You will need to choose your PMC faction again, customize the character's appearance and voice, reselect the modifiers, and start the season from the very beginning.

A seasonal character wipe does not affect your main PvP or PvE characters.
